meaning: True iff the referenced field currently holds a value.
constraints: the operand is a single field reference, not a bracketed field-value expression
gotchas: a field carrying a formal error is removed from evaluation, so 'FieldFilled(F) Or FieldNotFilled(F)' is not a tautology

validExample.note: true when Quantity has a value

meaning: True iff the referenced field is empty.
constraints: the operand is a single field reference
gotchas: FieldFilled and FieldNotFilled are not strict complements once formal errors are in play (see FieldFilled)

meaning: True iff both boolean operands are true.
constraints: both operands must be boolean conditions
gotchas: parentheses are required when mixing And with Or

validExample.note: fires only when both are filled

meaning: True iff at least one boolean operand is true.
constraints: both operands must be boolean conditions
gotchas: parentheses are required when mixing Or with And

meaning: True iff the left operand is less than or equal to the right.
constraints: ordering is legal only for numbers, amounts, and dates (not strings, enums, booleans, confirms, or date-ranges)
gotchas: the symbol is the same in every condition language (it is not a localized keyword)

validExample.note: fires when Quantity is zero or negative

invalidExample.fix: ordering needs numbers or dates; compare strings with == / != instead

meaning: True iff the two operands are equal.
constraints: operands must be type-compatible; two numbers must share the same decimal scale
gotchas: comparing numbers of different decimal scale is rejected — round to match
enums compare by stored value, never display text

invalidExample.fix: operands differ in decimal scale (0 vs 2); round one with RoundDown(..., n)

meaning: True iff the two operands are not equal.
constraints: operands must be type-compatible; two numbers must share the same decimal scale

validExample.note: fires when CustomerName is not ACME

invalidExample.fix: round operands to a common scale before comparing

meaning: The character length of a string field's value.
constraints: the operand must be a string field
gotchas: applying Length to a non-string field is a type error

validExample.note: fires when CustomerName is longer than 10 characters

invalidExample.fix: Length needs a string field, not a number
